sharedRules.name: HEAT
sharedRules.description: A Team's Armour rating is not increased by +1 if it is more than 16"/40cm away when hit by HEAT weapons.

sharedRules.name: Stormtroopers
sharedRules.description: A unit may attempt a second Movement Order after succeeding in its first Movement Order. The second Movement Order must be different from the first.

sharedRules.name: Third Reich
sharedRules.description: Troops of the Third Reich have a better Last Stand rating.

sharedRules.name: Tiger Ace
sharedRules.description: Tiger Aces have a better Last Stand rating and a significantly better Remount rating.

sharedRules.name: Escort Tanks
sharedRules.description:
You may add one Escort Tank, either a Panzer III (Uparmoured) or a Panzer III (7.5cm), for each Tiger tank in a Heavy Panzer Platoon for the points shown in the unit organisation. Use the characteristics shown on the Panzer  III Tank Platoon and Panzer III (uparmoured) Tank Platoon for these tanks.

Ignore Bailed Out or Destroyed Escort tanks when determining if the Unit is In Good Spirits, so if there are no Bailed Out or Destroyed Tiger tanks, the unit will be In Good Spritits.

A Tiger Heavy Tanks Platoon has a Last Stand rating of 2+, whether or not it has Escort tanks.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: When your opponent would first roll for Air Support, they automatically fail to receive Air Support for that turn.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
If this mission has Minefields, after Deployment you may redeply a Minefield marker anywhere outside your opponent's deployment area.

In Missions without Minefields, you may deploy a Minefield marker anywhere outside your opponent's deployment area before placing Objectives.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: At the start of a game, after deployment, reposition one of your opponent's Ranged In markers up to 6"/15cm in any direction.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
All of your Formation Commanders have their Commander Leadership range increased from 6"/15cm to 8"/20cm.

If you win the game, you gain one extra Victory Point; if you lose the game, you lose one Victory Point.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to re-roll any one die. The second result must be used.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
In each Shooting Step, pick one Infantry Team from this Unit. This team may re-roll one failed To Hit roll.

If this shot hits it target, that Team must re-roll their Save if it is successful.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: The Unit Leader in this Unit may re-roll one failed To Hit in each Shooting Step.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Tiger tanks in this Unit pass Cross tests on 2+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: The Unit Leader's Tiger tank has Halted ROF 3 with its 8.8cm gun.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
This Infantry or Gun Unit may add a Softskin Transport Attachment, The number of vehicles in the Unit is as follows: 
* Add one Softskin Transport for every two Infantry Teams in the Unit.
* Add one Softskin Transport for each Gun Team in the Unit.

rules.name: Passengers 2, Tractor
rules.description: Team can carry two Infantry Teams or one Gun Team as Passengers.

rules.name: Softskin
rules.description: If a Transport is Destroyed, any Passengers it is carrying are also Destroyed, and all Tranports must be Sent to the Rear immediately. All Passengers must Dismount from this Unit at the same time. Empty Tranpost Teams must be Sent to the Rear.

rules.name: Unarmoured
rules.description: Team cannot Charge into Contact and must Break Off if Assaulted.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: The Unit Leader may re-roll one failed Firepower Test during the Shooting Step.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Unit passes Blitz Move tests on 2+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to give Infantry and Gun teams in this Unit Anti-tank 3 and Firepower 1+ against Top Armour in Assaults until the end of the turn.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: The Formation Commander's Panzer III tank has Halted ROF 3 with its Short 5cm, Long 5cm, or 7.5cm gun.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: The Formation Commander may re-roll one failed Firepower Test during the Shooting Step.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Your HQ Unit has a Skill of 2+ when Ranging In its own Artillery Bombardment.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Your Formation Commander may roll two dice instead of one To Hit during Assaults.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Your HQ Unit passes Tactics tests for Movement Orders on 2+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Your HQ Unit is Concealed when Halted.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Hits by this Formation Commander may only be swapped using the Mistaken Target rule on 4+ instead of 3+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Place this card next to a building that your HQ Unit is occupying. For the rest of the game, Infantry Teams in this building have a 2+ save.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Discard this card after you win in an assault in which you Destroyed an enemy Tank Team. Remove one adjacent Infantry Team and add the enemy Tank to your force as a Captured Tank unit.

Use  the captured Tank's normal stats apart from its Is Hit On which becomes 2+. The captured Tank must add +1 to the score needed To Hit when it shoots. A Captured Tank Unit may not Launch an Assault and must always Break Off when assaulted.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Thie Formation Commander may re-roll failed To Hit rolls when Shooting during Defensive Fire while being assaulted.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card before rolling to automatically pass an Armour or Infantry Save (including all re-rolls) made by this Formation Commander.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: Discard this card to let Units in this Formation whose Unit Leader is within 8"/20cm of this Formation Commander pass Blitz Move Movement Orders on a 2+ until the end of the turn.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
If the Unit Leader of a Tank Unit in this Formation is within 6"/15cm and in Line of Sight of the Formation Commander, the Unit passes Shoot and Scoot tests on 2+.

The Formation Commander's Tank Team may re-roll one failed roll To Hit in each Shooting Step. This does not apply if his tank fires an Artillery Bombardment.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Increase this Formation Commander's Command Leadership distance from 6"/15cm to 8"/20cm.

Discard this card to automatically pass one Unit Last Stand Test for a Unit from this Formation whose Unit Leader is within 8"/20cm of the Formation Commander.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text:
Infantry Teams in Formation cross Minefields safely on a roll of 2+.
Infantry and Gun Teams in this Formations Dig In on a roll of 2+.

characteristics.name: Details
characteristics.$text: This Formation Commander Infantry Team Hits on 2+ in Assaults.
